name: io.github.GiulioDER/re-call
title: RE-call MCP Memory Server
description: Agent memory on your own Postgres that flags superseded facts and abstains instead of guessing.

environmentVariables.name: RECALL_SERVING_DSN
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL serving DSN for the RE-call memory store.

environmentVariables.name: RECALL_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: Tenant id served by this local stdio server.

environmentVariables.name: RECALL_TRUST_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Set to development only for local uncalibrated corpora.

environmentVariables.name: RECALL_EMBEDDER
environmentVariables.description: The embedder the corpus was BUILT with, for example voyage:voyage-4 or BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5. It must match: several models emit 1024 dimensions, so a mismatch does not error, it returns a confidently ranked list that means nothing.

environmentVariables.name: RECALL_TABLE
environmentVariables.description: The chunk table inside that database. `recall quickstart` indexes into quickstart_chunks so its sample corpus can never be retrieved beside real memory; `recall setup` uses chunks. The wrong value returns no hits and no error.

environmentVariables.name: RECALL_MCP_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Serve a subset of the tools: a preset (all, search, read) or explicit names. Every tool definition is re-sent every turn, so serving ones nobody calls costs input tokens on every turn. Unset serves them all.
